nodes.description: uint256 public totalSupply of the quaker token, minted and burned by mint/pullBack.
mapping(address => uint256) tokenBalances holding per-account token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
address public owner inherited from Ownable, controls onlyOwner functions.
address ownerWallet receiving the initial supply in the constructor.
uint256 constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 10000000 used for the constructor mint.
quaker(address wallet) constructor: sets owner, ownerWallet, totalSupply and initial balance.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public: moves tokens from msg.sender to _to.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public: moves tokens using allowance.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public: overwrites the allowance for msg.sender.
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) public: adds to the current allowance.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) public: subtracts from the current allowance.
mint(address wallet, address buyer, uint256 tokenAmount) onlyOwner: moves tokens from wallet to buyer and burns supply.
pullBack(address wallet, address buyer, uint256 tokenAmount) onlyOwner: reverses a mint moving tokens back and restoring supply.
balanceOf(address _owner) constant public: returns tokenBalances[_owner].
showMyTokenBalance(address addr) public view: returns the token balance of addr.
fallback function () public payable that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
totalSupply() constant public: returns totalSupply minus tokenBalances[address(0)].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant public: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner public: reassigns the owner address.
Ownable() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
msg.sender, attacker controllable caller used for balances, allowances and ownership checks.
Unchecked multiplication INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18 in the constructor (no SafeMath).
Raw subtraction totalSupply - tokenBalances[address(0)] in the totalSupply getter.
Balance write-back in transfer combining sub() and add() on tokenBalances under a require check.
Balance and allowance write-back in transferFrom combining sub()/add() under require checks.
totalSupply = totalSupply.sub(tokenAmount) in mint, reducing the reported supply.
totalSupply = totalSupply.add(tokenAmount) in pullBack, increasing the reported supply.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) allowance increment in increaseApproval.
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) allowance decrement in decreaseApproval.
wallet parameter of the quaker constructor, receives the initial supply.
_to parameter of transfer, destination of the token transfer.
_value parameter of transfer, amount of tokens moved.
_from parameter of transferFrom, source account debited.
_to parameter of transferFrom, destination account credited.
_value parameter of transferFrom, amount moved and allowance consumed.
_spender parameter of approve, account granted the allowance.
_value parameter of approve, new allowance amount.
_spender parameter of increaseApproval.
_addedValue parameter of increaseApproval, added to the allowance.
_spender parameter of decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue parameter of decreaseApproval, removed from the allowance.
oldValue local cache of allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in decreaseApproval.
_owner parameter of balanceOf, queried account.
balance return variable of balanceOf.
wallet parameter of mint, account debited (seller).
buyer parameter of mint, account credited.
tokenAmount parameter of mint, amount moved and burned from totalSupply.
wallet parameter of pullBack, account credited back.
buyer parameter of pullBack, account debited.
tokenAmount parameter of pullBack, amount moved and re-added to totalSupply.
addr parameter of showMyTokenBalance, queried account.
tokenBalance return variable of showMyTokenBalance.
tokenOwner parameter of allowance, owner of the funds.
spender parameter of allowance, approved spender.
remaining return variable of allowance.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership, the new privileged account.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting privileged control derived from an untrusted caller.
Constructor parameter wallet is used to seed tokenBalances[wallet].
Constructor writes totalSupply from INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor assigns ownerWallet from the wallet parameter.
Constructor executes the unchecked INITIAL_SUPPLY * 10 ** 18 multiplication.
Immutable INITIAL_SUPPLY feeds the unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
transfer debits and credits tokenBalances based on the untrusted msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes the tokenBalances mapping of both parties.
transfer performs the balance sub/add write-back operations.
_to is used as the credited destination in transfer.
_value determines the magnitude of the balance updates in transfer.
transferFrom consumes allowed[_from][msg.sender] using the untrusted caller address.
transferFrom reads and writes tokenBalances for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and updates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs combined balance and allowance sub/add writes.
_from selects the debited balance and allowance owner in transferFrom.
_to is the credited destination in transferFrom.
_value sets the size of the balance and allowance updates in transferFrom.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] keyed by the untrusted caller.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
_spender selects the allowance slot written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount stored by approve.
increaseApproval modifies allowed[msg.sender][_spender] based on the untrusted caller.
increaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval executes the allowance addition operation.
_spender selects the allowance slot in increaseApproval.
_addedValue is the operand of the allowance addition.
decreaseApproval modifies allowed[msg.sender][_spender] using the untrusted caller.
decreaseApproval reads and writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval executes the allowance subtraction operation.
_spender selects the allowance slot in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is the operand of the allowance subtraction.
decreaseApproval declares and assigns the oldValue local.
oldValue is the minuend of the allowance subtraction in decreaseApproval.
mint is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
mint moves balances between wallet and buyer in tokenBalances.
mint reduces totalSupply by the minted amount, making the supply inconsistent with balances.
mint executes totalSupply.sub(tokenAmount).
wallet is the debited seller account in mint.
buyer is the credited account in mint.
tokenAmount is subtracted from totalSupply in mint.
tokenAmount drives the balance sub/add writes in mint.
pullBack is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
pullBack moves balances between buyer and wallet in tokenBalances.
pullBack re-adds the amount to totalSupply, further decoupling supply from balances.
pullBack executes totalSupply.add(tokenAmount).
wallet is the credited account in pullBack.
buyer is the debited account in pullBack.
tokenAmount is added back to totalSupply in pullBack.
tokenAmount drives the balance sub/add writes in pullBack.
totalSupply getter reads the totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply getter subtracts tokenBalances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
totalSupply getter performs a raw subtraction that can underflow.
allowance getter reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner selects the allowance owner in allowance().
spender selects the allowance spender in allowance().
allowance returns the remaining allowance local variable.
balanceOf reads the tokenBalances mapping.
_owner selects the queried account in balanceOf.
balanceOf returns the balance local variable.
showMyTokenBalance reads the tokenBalances mapping.
addr selects the queried account in showMyTokenBalance.
showMyTokenBalance returns the tokenBalance local variable.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to owner.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner state variable.
newOwner parameter becomes the new privileged owner.
Ownable constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the root of all privilege.
Ownable constructor initialises the owner state variable.
msg.sender is the value written into the owner variable, controlling onlyOwner paths.
